description.value: Persian Baanou Supermarket is a Persian grocery store located in North Vancouver on Sixth Street. Touring cyclists looking for Middle Eastern and Persian specialty products — including pantry staples, prepared foods, and imported goods not found in mainstream supermarkets — will find this a useful stop. The supermarket format suggests a reasonably broad selection for restocking supplies.
